    depth=distance-height*np.sin(elev)-BR*normal_z
    return rgb,a,depth


def tool_layer(dy,opening):
    rgb=np.zeros((H,W,3),np.float32); a=np.zeros((H,W),np.float32)
    # Extending the shaft from outside the image maintains a continuous tool.
    bottom=int(np.ceil(21+dy))
    if bottom>0:
        ys=np.clip((np.arange(bottom)*.08).astype(int),0,19)
        crop=shaft_texture[ys]
        for yy in range(min(bottom,H)):
            rgb[yy,251:268]=crop[yy]
            a[yy,252:266]=1
        a=cv2.GaussianBlur(a,(0,0),.45)
    matrix=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,1,dy]],np.float32)
    head_rgb=cv2.warpAffine(SOURCE.astype(np.float32),matrix,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
    head_a=cv2.warpAffine(alpha_tool,matrix,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
    rgb=rgb*(1-head_a[:,:,None])+head_rgb*head_a[:,:,None]
    a=np.maximum(a,head_a)
    # Two narrow blue-black fingers curve around the ball; no human enters the shot.
    scale=3
    jaws=Image.new('RGBA',(W*scale,H*scale),(0,0,0,0))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(jaws)
    c=260.; y=127+dy
    for sign in [-1,1]:
        shift=opening*10
        path=[(c+sign*11,y-34),(c+sign*(19+shift),y-24),(c+sign*(23+shift),y-7),
              (c+sign*(21+shift),y+9),(c+sign*(16+shift),y+12),
              (c+sign*(16+shift),y+6),(c+sign*(18+shift),y-6),(c+sign*(15+shift),y-20),(c+sign*8,y-29)]
        d.polygon([(round(px*scale),round(py*scale)) for px,py in path],fill=(11,23,34,255))
        line=[(c+sign*12,y-29),(c+sign*(17+shift),y-21),(c+sign*(20+shift),y-6),(c+sign*(18+shift),y+6)]
        d.line([(round(px*scale),round(py*scale)) for px,py in line],fill=(26,63,88,255),width=3,joint='curve')
    j=np.asarray(jaws.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(np.float32)
    ja=j[:,:,3]/255
    # RGB kept straight-alpha for the global compositor.
    rgb=rgb*(1-ja[:,:,None])+j[:,:,:3]*ja[:,:,None]
    a=np.maximum(a,ja)
    height=239-Y
    z=distance-height*np.sin(elev)-6
    return rgb,a,z


def render(t):
    angle=paper_motion(t)
    dy,ball_y,opening=tool_motion(t)
    canvas=background.copy()
    # Soft contact shadow on the surface, getting tighter as the ball is lowered.
    gap=max(0,218-ball_y)
    shadow_strength=.26*np.exp(-gap/49)
    sx=BR*(.93+gap*.009); sy=5+gap*.08
    shadow=np.exp(-.5*(((X-262)/sx)**2+((Y-239)/sy)**2))*shadow_strength
    canvas*=1-shadow[:,:,None]
    # Subtle paper shadow, laid across the dark platform.
    corners,dp=project(world_corners(angle))
    shadowpoly=np.array([corners[3]+[3,3],corners[2]+[3,3],corners[2]+[8,10],corners[3]+[8,10]],np.int32)
    sm=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillConvexPoly(sm,shadowpoly,255)
    sm=cv2.GaussianBlur(sm.astype(np.float32)/255,(0,0),3.2)*.09
    canvas*=1-sm[:,:,None]
    br,ba,bz=ball_layer(260,ball_y)
    tr,ta,tz=tool_layer(dy,opening)
    pr,pa,pz,pc=render_sheet(angle)
    # Compose each moving layer per camera depth rather than making the ball
    # pop through the card during the turn. The original back/front relation
    # changes continuously as the paper turns around its vertical axis.
    sphere_depth=np.where(ba>.01,bz,np.inf)
    grab_depth=np.where(ta>.01,tz,np.inf)
    sheet_depth=np.where(pa>.01,pz,np.inf)
    # gripper fingers are in front of the sphere, paper can occlude either.
    canvas=composite(canvas,br,ba*(sphere_depth>sheet_depth))
    canvas=composite(canvas,tr,ta*(grab_depth>sheet_depth))
    canvas=composite(canvas,pr,pa)
    canvas=composite(canvas,br,ba*(sphere_depth<=sheet_depth))
    canvas=composite(canvas,tr,ta*(grab_depth<=sheet_depth))
    return np.clip(canvas,0,255).astype(np.uint8)

if __name__=='__main__':
    frames=np.stack([SOURCE if i==0 else render(i/24) for i in range(120)])
    assert np.array_equal(frames[0],SOURCE)

    Image.fromarray(np.clip(background,0,255).astype(np.uint8)).save(ROOT/'.tmp/recovered.png')
